Subject: Marquette Inns Submission - Referral Required

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the Marquette Inns submission. I've reviewed the materials and everything looks complete—appreciate the thorough package!

However, hospitality risks require referral to our senior underwriting team for approval. Before I send this up, could you help me with a few questions?

- What are the occupancy types at each location (full-service hotel, limited-service, extended stay)?
- Are there any restaurants, bars, or conference facilities on-site?
- What fire protection is in place (sprinklers, alarms, distance to fire station)?
- Any recent renovations or updates to the properties?

Once I have these details, I'll escalate this for review and circle back with you quickly.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
